req.title: Emit OpenAPI schema
req.statement: The system shall serve an OpenAPI 3.x JSON specification at GET /openapi.json.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-017 requires GET /openapi.json to return HTTP 2xx with a valid OpenAPI 3.x JSON payload. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — happy path returns 200 with correct Content-Type and top-level OpenAPI fields matching the app's configured metadata; (2) negative NEG — wrong HTTP method (POST) returns 405, confirming the endpoint is read-only; (3) boundary BVA — the exact openapi version string starts with '3.' (not '2.' or missing), and the info block contains the exact title/version strings declared in main.py. Each test asserts exact values to kill constant-mutation, comparison-flip, and boolean-negation mutants.

tests.name: test_get_openapi_json_returns_200_with_valid_schema
preconditions: GET /openapi.json is served by FastAPI automatically
expected: Top-level key 'openapi' exists and starts with '3.'
Top-level key 'info' exists with correct title and version
trace: R-PLAYER-017: system shall serve OpenAPI 3.x JSON at GET /openapi.json
Expected outcome: HTTP 2xx response with expected payload
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_openapi_json_returns_200_with_valid_schema():
    client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)
    r = client.get('/openapi.json')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get('content-type', '')
    assert 'application/json' in ct
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body, dict)
    assert 'openapi' in body
    assert body['openapi'].startswith('3.')
    assert 'info' in body
    assert body['info']['title'] == 'python-samples-fastapi-restful'
    assert body['info']['version'] == '1.0.0'
    assert 'paths' in body
    assert isinstance(body['paths'], dict)

test_get_openapi_json_returns_200_with_valid_schema()

tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_openapi_json_openapi_version_is_3x_not_2x():
    client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)
    r = client.get('/openapi.json')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    openapi_version = body.get('openapi', '')
    assert openapi_version != ''
    assert openapi_version.startswith('3.')
    major = openapi_version.split('.')[0]
    assert major == '3'
    assert not openapi_version.startswith('2.')
    info = body.get('info', {})
    assert info.get('description') == (
        '🧪 Proof of Concept for a RESTful API made with Python 3 and FastAPI'
    )
    assert info.get('title') == 'python-samples-fastapi-restful'
    assert info.get('version') == '1.0.0'

test_get_openapi_json_openapi_version_is_3x_not_2x()

from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_openapi_json_paths_contain_player_routes():
    client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)
    r = client.get('/openapi.json')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    paths = body.get('paths', {})
    assert isinstance(paths, dict)
    assert '/players/' in paths
    assert '/players/{player_id}' in paths
    assert '/players/squadnumber/{squad_number}' in paths
    players_path = paths['/players/']
    assert 'get' in players_path
    assert 'post' in players_path

test_get_openapi_json_paths_contain_player_routes()

PlayerRequestModel or PlayerResponseModel schema is present

BVA: boundary — non-empty payload with schema components
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_openapi_json_response_body_is_not_empty_and_has_components():
    client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)
    r = client.get('/openapi.json')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    raw = r.content
    assert len(raw) > 0
    body = r.json()
    assert 'components' in body
    components = body['components']
    assert isinstance(components, dict)
    assert 'schemas' in components
    schemas = components['schemas']
    assert isinstance(schemas, dict)
    schema_names = list(schemas.keys())
    assert len(schema_names) > 0
    found_player = any('Player' in name for name in schema_names)
    assert found_player is True

test_get_openapi_json_response_body_is_not_empty_and_has_components()
